      "Maintain professional output quality",

        "Collect job application context if applicable",
        "Detect message type transitions requiring regeneration",
        "Prompt user for reasoning display preference",
        "Produce response-optimized LinkedIn outreach artifact",
        "Support audience options: C_LEVEL, EXECUTIVE, SENIOR_TA, RECRUITER, SHORT_NEW",
        "Apply route-specific constraints (char limits, K-node modifications)",

        "Handle K.3-K.4 regeneration for message type transitions",

      }
    }

  "3.global_enforcement_rules": {

            1,
            2
          ],
          "achievements_required": 0
        }

      "by_route": {
        "CONNECTION_REQ": {
          "hard_char_limit": 330,
          "force_message_type": "SHORT_NEW",
          "k_nodes_disabled": [
            "K.2",
            "K.4",
            "K.6"
          ],
          "k3_mode": "compressed",
          "k5_mode": "micro"
        },

          "subject_limit": 60
        },
        "FOLLOW_UP": {
          "reference_prior": true,

          "multi_recipient": true,
          "independent_execution": true

      }
    },
    "k_node_constraints": {
      "universal": {
        "ascii_only": true,
        "no_emojis": true,
        "no_special_chars": [

          "®",
          "©",
          "…",
          "—",
          "'",
          "'",
          "\"",
          "\""

          "EXECUTIVE",
          "SENIOR_TA",
          "RECRUITER",
          "SHORT_NEW"
        ],
        "confidence_min": 0.95,
        "deterministic": true
      },
      "K2": {
        "char_limit": 60,

        "distinct_from": [

          "K5"
        ],
        "confidence_min": 0.9
      },
      "K3": {
        "word_limit": "@global.message_constraints.by_type.{type}.word_range",

        "readability_min": 60,
        "confidence_min": 0.88

      "K4": {

          "EXECUTIVE": "resume",
          "SENIOR_TA": "resume_required",
          "RECRUITER": "resume_ats"
        },
        "link_validation": "HTTP_200",
        "confidence_min": 0.95
      },
      "K5": {

          "EXECUTIVE": 20,
          "SENIOR_TA": 20,

          "schedule",
          "discuss",
          "explore",
          "meet"
        ],

      },
      "K6": {

          "title",
          "phone",
          "email",

        ],

    "parameter_constraints": {

    "enforcement_priority": {
